long_biography.plain_text:
Kaalbye Shipping grew around an Odesa network that moved specialist cargo through chartering, crewing, freight forwarding, bulk transport and heavy-lift work. Boris Kogan was one of the Ukrainian company's co-founders, a director and senior manager, placing him at the centre of its commercial operation.

Kogan also sat on the board of RT-Logistika, extending his reach into a larger Russian transport organisation. His other Odesa interests included two business centres, a nightclub and coastal land. He died suddenly in Odesa in October 2017, one day after his sixty-first birthday, leaving a career defined by Black Sea shipping and cross-border logistics.
